Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden, include) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (coverage) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.retry (Drone has no retry key; only clone.retries exists)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common job.retry (Drone has no retry key; only clone.retries exists)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/common/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (extends, interruptible, resource_group) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod job.retry (Drone has no retry key; only clone.retries exists)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/prod/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every pipeline document (a step variable of the same name wins)
